 Head Coach Brian Schmetzer reveals his lineup for tonight's away match against San Diego FC (7:30 p.m. PT; Watch on Apple TV , 950 KJR AM , El Rey 1360AM ) at Snapdragon Stadium. Here is the Delta Starting XI:
 LINEUP NOTES:
 Head Coach Brian Schmetzer makes three changes coming off a 1-1 draw with CF Montréal on October 17, with Sebastian Gomez scoring for the Rave Green to earn the point at Lumen Field.
 Sounders FC kicks off a three-match week with a road fixture at San Diego FC on Saturday, October 24 at Snapdragon Stadium (7:30 p.m. PT / Apple TV , 950 KJR AM , El Rey 1360 AM ).
 Seattle is in seventh place in the Western Conference with 42 points (11-10-9). San Diego is 13th place in the West with 34 points (8-12-10).
 Saturday is just the fourth meeting between the two sides, with San Diego joining MLS last year. The series is tied 1-1-1, including a 1-1 draw earlier this year at Lumen Field.
 Following Saturday's match, Seattle faces Houston Dynamo FC on Wednesday, October 28 on the Emerald Queen Casino Pitch at Lumen Field (7:30 p.m. PT / Apple TV, iHeartMedia Seattle, El Rey 1360 AM).
